newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Colonial to start stockbroking unit.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Colonial to start stockbroking unit.

text.p: Insurance and banking group Colonial Ltd said on Thursday that it would start a stockbroking operation next month.
The company plans to list on the Australian and New Zealand stock exchanges by the end of June this year.
It said Colonial Stockbroking Ltd would provide broking and advisory services for retail clients and would be led by Frank Dunphy as managing director.
Dunphy joined Colonial in January this year and had previously worked for Epic Securities and Shaw Stockbroking.
